# MCP Agentic Wallet — llms.txt

> Open-source EIP-2612 Permit-based wallet sessions for AI agents using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
> Reference implementation for paid MCP servers. Verify signatures, manage sessions, settle on-chain via USDC on Base.

- Repository: https://github.com/MCPVOT/mcp-agentic-wallet
- License: MIT
- NPM: `@mcp-agentic-wallet/core`
- MCP Registry: `io.github.MCPVOT/mcp-agentic-wallet`
- Production user: https://mcpvot.xyz

## What this is (one paragraph)

A framework-agnostic TypeScript library that lets any MCP server accept **gasless, EIP-2612 Permit-based** payments from a human's wallet, mint a session token the agent uses in headers, and settle each tool call on-chain via `transferFrom` (USDC on Base Mainnet). The human signs ONE permit (max $100 USDC, max 30 days); the agent uses the resulting session token for thousands of paid MCP calls without re-prompting the human. No API keys, no recurring charges.

## For AI agents / MCP clients

Add this server to your MCP client config:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "mcp-agentic-wallet": {
      "url": "https://mcpvot.xyz/api/mcp",
      "headers": { "Session-Token": "maw_<your-token>" }
    }
  }
}
```

Get a session token: a human visits https://mcpvot.xyz/wallet, connects any EIP-1193 wallet (MetaMask, Coinbase, Brave, Binance Chain, Trust, WalletConnect, Rainbow), signs an EIP-2612 Permit, and copies the token. Full agent flow: see `/docs/AGENT-FLOW.md`.

## Library API (`@mcp-agentic-wallet/core`)

| Export | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `InMemoryStore` | Pluggable session store (KV/Redis in prod) |
| `verifyPermit(params)` | Verifies EIP-712 Permit signature on-chain (viem) |
| `submitPermit(params, config)` | Submits `permit()` tx to USDC contract |
| `settleCall(human, amount, config)` | Calls `transferFrom(human, treasury, amount)` |
| `checkAllowance(owner, spender, rpc?)` | Reads on-chain USDC allowance |
| `checkRateLimit(wallet)` | Per-wallet rate limit (5/hr) |
| `toSessionInfo(session)` | Safe client-facing session projection |

## Types (TS)

```ts
interface WalletSession {
  sessionToken: string;
  humanAddress: string;        // 42-char hex, lowercase
  allowance: bigint;           // USDC atomic units (1 USDC = 1_000_000)
  used: bigint;
  deadline: number;            // unix seconds
  label: string;
  permit: PermitData;
  suspended: boolean;
  settlementFailures: number;
}

interface ConsumeResult { ok: boolean; remaining: bigint; reason?: string; }
interface SettlementResult { ok: boolean; txHash?: `0x${string}`; error?: string; }
```

## Key constants

- Base Mainnet chain ID: `8453`
- USDC contract: `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`
- 1 USDC atomic = `1_000_000n` (6 decimals)
- EIP-712 domain: `{ name: "USD Coin", version: "2", chainId: 8453, verifyingContract: "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913" }`

## Files in this repo

- `packages/core/` — framework-agnostic library (`@mcp-agentic-wallet/core`)

- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` — system design + payment flow diagrams

- `server.json` — MCP Registry metadata
- `agents.json` — agent-readable project metadata (A2A)
- `.well-known/mcp.json` — well-known MCP discovery file

## Use Case: iRacing + Blockchain (Sim-Racing Prize Pools)

MCPVOT uses this wallet library to power **on-chain sim-racing events** — the first integration of iRacing Data API with blockchain prize escrow:

1. **Host creates event** — deploys an escrow smart contract on Base with entry fee + prize pool
2. **Drivers connect wallet** — sign EIP-2612 Permit via this library, get a session token (gasless, 1-time)
3. **Drivers pay entry fee** — `transferFrom` settles the entry to the escrow contract
4. **Race happens in iRacing** — server polls iRacing Data API (`/data/results/get`) for finish order
5. **Smart contract auto-disburses** — verified winners receive USDC from the prize pool

Three iRacing MCP tools are live at `mcpvot.xyz` using this session-token payment flow:
- `get_race_results` ($0.02) — full race results, finish order, laps, incidents, iRating changes
- `lookup_driver` ($0.01) — driver profile, iRating, license class, career stats
- `search_hosted_races` ($0.02) — search hosted races by date range, driver, or session name

## Security defaults

- Max allowance: **$100 USDC per session**
- Max deadline: **30 days**
- Rate limit: **5 authorizations / wallet / hour**
- Auto-suspend: **after 3 failed settlements**
- EIP-712 signature verification on every permit
- Human can revoke anytime via `/api/wallet/revoke`
